  • The Station Title of this Station is '''Chromatic Equitocracy'''.
  • This Stations features The Cuisine, and the Station Menu is "Beef Sliders with Pickles and Mustard".
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".

Fun Facts

  • This station is the last station to be built in 2021.
  • To Pay tribute to Stand News, a now-defunct Online News Website based in Hong Kong, a Station Art resembling the icon of Stand News is also built above the Concourse of this Station. This arrangement is similar to that of Apple Hill Station.
  • Despite being built at the same continent as the then-unnamed Teraleros and Poloros, this station administratively belonged to Jupiter as it is situated at the Exclave of Jupiter in that continent. This arrangement is similar to Tsuen Wan District having an exclave on Lantau Island in Hong Kong as most of the Lantau Island belongs to the Islands District.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VP_whaKn_Q&t=3327s</ref>
  • With an interstation distance of 10.18 km between this station and Cranerock Mount Station, it holds the record for the longest non-express train, non-veloduct interstation distance of any Standard Railway Nazca Railway line in Los Sengas Division. Due to the long interstation distance involved, signs are placed at each kilometer on The Great Liberty Bridge to indicate the distance to and from this station and Cranerock Mount Station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VP_whaKn_Q&t=3151s</ref>
  • After going through The Great Liberty Bridge, the next station announcement would be played once again on both sides. A similar arrangement is also seen for before entering Internal Sea East Station and Flask East Checkpoint.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VP_whaKn_Q&t=3431s</ref>
  • Due to the black and white color scheme of this station, colored wool would be placed at each platform representing the line served by that station. The colored side would be placed at the travelling direction of the platform.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VP_whaKn_Q&t=3675s</ref>

Future Development

  • While it was not explicitly mentioned in the Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline, , and '''India Line''' will serve this station as seen from the Station Control Room of this station.

title: Mayler Airport
safeHtml:
'''Mayler Airport''' is the first public airport and International Airport in Los Sengas located at Sava Threeler in Los Sengas. While it originally opened as a public airport, it was subsequently converted to a private airport before being once again converted to a public airport.

History

  • June 16 2015: Mayler Airport completed construction, and space was reserved for Mayler Airport Station.
  • May 16 2016: Due to works and the expansion of Mayler Airport, the old station was demolished.
  • August 31 2024: Mayler Airport 1 Station completed construction.
  • September 4 2024: Mayler Airport 1 Station began operations.
  • September 21 2024: is established and began to serve Mayler Airport 1 Station. At the same day, the Terminal 1 Ramp became connected to the runway.
  • October 3 2024: Nazca Railway has announced the construction of Mayler Airport 2 Station for and .https://www.facebook.com/NazcaRailwayLS/posts/pfbid02nYTv1CKXrr4Qh6zJ3UefiMJwmBMhcXpUS4gtE635ySsASmmVPjJn3sG18wJePAn8l</ref>
  • October 8 2024: Mayler Airport 2 Station completed construction.
  • October 20 2024: Mayler Airport 2 Station began operations.
  • 2024: Mayler Airport completed expansion.

Composition

Mayler Airport features a total of two terminals, with Terminal 1 having a total of 15 boarding gates, and Terminal 2 having a total of 18 boarding gates. Terminal 1 boarding gates are marked by the Letter "A" (A1-A15) whereas Terminal 2 boarding gates are marked by the Letter "B" (B1-B18), bringing the total number of boarding gates to 33.

In addition, all 33 boarding gates serve a single north-south oriented runway which is 3'000m long and paved by concrete. However, instead of the conventional 18/36, the runway number is denoted as (08/26), which typically stands for a east-west oriented runway.

safeHtml:
'''Melody''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-05.

History

There has been speculation regarding the origins of the name Melody. One of them has to do with paying homage to Georgina Chan, a member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other symbolizes the fact that this district was the birthplace of a musician who was good at crafting mesmerizing melodies that bring joy to its listeners.

Early on in the planning phases, a Major Shopping mall and a Topside Development has already been planned for this Sub-District. While the source of inspiration was unknown at the time, what was clear was that there will be a shopping mall in this Sub-District to gather visitors. Subseqeuntly, Ocean Pride in West Tseun Wan District was chosen as the inspiration of that Shopping Mall, and a replica of Ocean Pride was hence built in this District, complete with a reserved Railway Exit within the Shopping Mall Structure. As a homage to Ocean Pride, this Shopping Mall Project is named "Collar Pride".

It should be noted that Kam Leung Estate, despite being located in this Sub-District, is administered by the Arctic Sea Sub-District, and can be seen as an Exclave of Arctic Sea Sub-District within this Sub-District.
